_comment: v5.0 (paired with MCU firmware v4.0.0, raw sampling build). The MCU only sends raw counts; conversion constants (divider ratio, VREF, ADC bits, BH1750 lux/count) are taken from what MCU get_config() reports; this file holds the Linux-side algorithm parameters and thresholds. v5.0 removed constants no longer used since the v3 era (blank_slope, theory_slope, viscosity table, tee_a/b, n_eff_nominal, etc.; see documentation 4.1(5)). Entries marked in provisional_constants are provisional values and must be recalibrated after any configuration change.
_aggregate_comment: Sampling window: pressure and flow are collected over this period and reduced to median/mean, giving the displayed value and one CSV row. This value is also synced to the MCU as the OD600 measurement interval (all three share the same sampling duration), and it can be changed live in the web UI; the value here is only the boot default. aggregate_method may be "median" or "mean".

thresholds._comment: tmp_critical_bar: absolute upper limit for TMP_mean and the instantaneous TMP peak (collapse protection), also the default for the pinch valve MCU interlock; tmp_trough_negative_bar: alarm when the instantaneous TMP trough (after subtracting rho*g*h/2) falls below this value. The other v4.x thresholds are no longer used.

_v3_comment: The valve block is pushed to the MCU as initial values only when ph_valve_state.json has no saved pinch valve settings yet; after that, the settings saved from the web UI take precedence.

valve._comment: tmp_limit_bar defaults to the same value as thresholds.tmp_critical_bar. v4.0.0 firmware: the MCU checks every converted 10 ms pressure sample, and only after 5 consecutive samples (50 ms) over the limit does it automatically open the valve and latch FAULT; feed_basis 0 = instantaneous value, 1 = average over the last 1 s. The open/closed positions must be measured and saved in the web UI 'Pinch valve settings' panel.

algorithms._comment: Boot defaults (switching in the web UI saves and takes precedence). Since v5.0 everything runs in Python: flow=gate|reciprocal, od_estimator=mad|qn|biweight|upper|mean|median|p75|p90, analysis_source=ema|raw, steady=legacy|ci, curvature=legacy|quadfit. v5.1 changes the default od_estimator from upper to mad (bubbles make the light brighter in V1, and upper only takes the bright samples so it errs the most; mad makes no bet on bubble direction, and on clean data all 8 estimators agree) - a new blank must be taken after switching algorithms. The combination is reciprocal / mad / raw / ci / quadfit; older saved settings (algorithms in ph_valve_state.json) still take precedence.

hfm._comment: v4 HFM derived parameters (per HFM_bioreactor_UI_spec.md). rho_gh is replaced by the value measured in the boot self-test; the dP-Q baseline a*Q + b*Q^2 (kPa, Q in mL/min) can be edited in the web UI or set via 'use current state as baseline'. v5.0: when mu_from_temp = 1, mu = viscosity of water at the DS18B20 temperature x mu_water_factor (medium relative to water); mu_cp is used only when the temperature cannot be read. rho_gh_kpa_default 5.9 is the theoretical value for a fully vertical 60 cm; when mounted at an angle (about 40-50 cm high) use the self-test measurement. v5.1: gamma_max_s1 changed from 6000 to 11000 and redefined - this is not a cell tolerance limit, but the validity limit of the laminar flow model (Re<2000, corresponding to Q_L~715 mL/min); beyond it gamma_flow=8v/d and tau_w themselves no longer hold. Measured: at 6000 s^-1 (Q_L~390) Bacillus subtilis still grew to OD600 3.5 and kept producing protein for 60+ hours. alarm_tmp_out_excess_kpa: during closed periods, warn of high shell-side pressure when TMP_out is more negative than its expected value (-dPf/2) by more than this amount.

flow._comment: ZJ-TM02 large-bore version 2580 pulses/L (F = 43*Q), small-bore version 5160 (and change max_flow_mlmin to 1000). Since v5.0 the conversion is done in Python, so switching versions does not require reflashing the MCU.

pressure._comment: Every 200 ms, compute peak/trough/mean from the 100 Hz samples of the last stats_window_s seconds; once the pump pulsation frequency f is measured, automatically extend to stats_window_cycles / f seconds (at most stats_window_max_s) to ensure several pulsation cycles are covered.

od600._comment: optical_mode: fiber (dual light path, reference compensates the LED) or single (sample only). bubble_drop_pct: a lit reading more than this % below the upper envelope P90 counts as a bubble; when more than half are bubbles, all algorithms mark the measurement invalid and immediately re-measure once (bubble_retry). Algorithms are the same as inline photometer v1.2.0. v5.1: added gate (OD gate layer after the estimator).

growth_rate._comment: v6.1 specific growth rate mu = slope of ln(OD600 reported) vs time (1/h), least-squares over the last window_min minutes of gate-accepted readings above min_od. Needs min_points readings spanning min_span_min. Restarts after a declared operation, a confirmed level shift, a new blank / estimator / path-length factor, or a gate reset. Adjustable in the web UI (OD600 gating layer section).

gate._comment: v5.1 OD gate layer after the estimator (od_gate.py). disc: |od(primary) - od_p90| > max(disc_abs, disc_rel*|od|) is judged a bubble; jump: a difference from the last accepted value > max(jump_abs, jump_rel*|last value|) first goes into a candidate set, and only when confirm_n candidates agree with each other is it accepted as a new level and an alarm raised; reports the median of the last report_median_n accepted values; stale_n consecutive rejected readings raise a stall alarm. Thresholds are written into recordings/<recording>_raw/meta.json before the run as pre-registration, and can later be recomputed with different thresholds via tools/replay_od.py --gate-*. disc_rel defaults to 0.015: simulation shows |mad-p90| of clean readings can reach 0.035 at OD 3.5, so an absolute threshold of 0.03 alone starts to falsely reject (about 0.8% at OD 4.0); with the relative term, false rejections are 0 for OD 0.1-4.0, and detection power for brightening bubbles is unchanged (|mad-p90| is 0.14-0.88, far above the threshold). To exactly reproduce the settings validated on the 10/10 dataset, set disc_rel to 0.

raw_logging._comment: During recording, write the MCU raw data to recordings/<recording>_raw/ (pressure at 100 Hz is about 300 MB per day uncompressed, about 1/4 after hourly gzip). When free disk drops below disk_warn_mb the web UI warns; below disk_stop_mb raw data is stopped (the aggregate CSV continues).

_v6_comment: v6.0 (paired with MCU firmware v4.1.0) adds: pressure_protect (any of the three channels over limit for 50 ms consecutively -> stop main pump + stop base dosing + open pinch valve + latch), base_pump (second L298N base pump), aux_valves (shell sampling valve / feed valve STS3215), ph_control (automatic base dosing). These are initial values; values changed and saved in the web UI (ph_valve_state.json) take precedence.

pressure_protect._comment: Any of the Feed/Retentate/Permeate channels > limit_bar for 5 consecutive 10 ms samples -> the MCU stops the main pump + stops base dosing + opens the pinch valve and latches; effective whether the pinch valve is open or closed. The main pump cannot start until cleared.

base_pump._comment: L298N six consecutive pins D8-D13: IN1=D8, ENA=D9, IN2=D10, ENB=D11, IN3=D12, IN4=D13. MCU side: single pulse 0.1-10 s, will not run unless the feed valve is at the 'base dosing' position, cumulative run time per hour limited to max_s_per_hour seconds (0 = disabled).

aux_valves._comment: STS3215 factory ID is always 1 (= pinch valve). Connect new servos to the bus one at a time and use the web UI 'Change servo ID' to change them to 2 (shell) and 3 (feed) before connecting the next one. Angles: shell fully closed 315 deg / to pressure gauge 270 deg / fully open (pressure gauge + collection bottle) 0 deg; feed fully closed 315 deg / base dosing 270 deg / external feed 180 deg. Actual positions are defined by 'Save as this position' in the web UI.

ph_control._comment: Base dosing only. pH < target - deadband starts a cycle: feed valve turns to base dosing -> dose for pulse_s seconds -> wait at least settle_min_s with slope within steady_window_s < steady_slope_per_min (at most settle_max_s) -> pH >= target ends the cycle, otherwise dose again. no_response_n consecutive times with pH rise < min_response_ph -> FAULT (base solution empty / line clogged). pH > high_alarm only raises an alarm. Enabling can only be toggled in the web UI (disabled by default).
